strengths: Highest base BAT in the game
Counters heroes with very high or very low mana pools

game_plan.early: Farm defensively & only join good fights with low to no risk of dying.
game_plan.mid: Split-push lanes when your team is pushing the opposite side of the map. Or consider showing up for an important objective, but never go into the fight first.
game_plan.late: Pick off isolated heroes with Blink. Use Mana Void to punish high-mana enemies in team fights.
game_plan.extras: Manta, BKB and Counterspell will protect you against most of the spells in the game. But each game during the drafting stage make a conscious note of whether there are any spells on the enemy team that will ruin your day even after you have those items. If you identify such abilities - always stay on the fringes of team fights until you see them being used up and then go in.

skill_builds.name: Skill Build 1 - Mana Void
skill_builds.note: When the enemy team has an extremely high Max Mana core, you can use him to AoE nuke and win entire teamfights with Mana Void.

skill_builds.name: Skill Build 2 - Stand Your Ground
skill_builds.note: Often times by the time you hit level 3, you'll be able to make an educated guess on how the lane is going to proceed. In cases where you need a little extra umph and Counterspell can provide it in order to keep laning successfully, go with this build.

item_builds.name: Item Build 1 - Standard
item_builds.note: Battle Fury is the quintessential farming item for Anti-Mage. The rest of the build allows you to easily pick off squishy heroes and split pushers by yourself. It also provides you with purge, self-dispel and highest possible Manabreak against most heroes in the early & mid game.

item_builds.name: Item Build 2 - Survivability
item_builds.note: You have it all on the defensive spectrum - magic resistance, evasion, debuff immunity, lifesteal, 2x self-dispels, and CC on demand with Abyssal Blade. With this build you're relying on your team to provide CC and commit properly to team fights. But in the meantime you're an absolute monster to take down. Make sure to engage with your team and output maximum DPS. If your backline falls apart before you kill their key heroes, you're quite likely to lose the fight afterwards.

situational_items.note: Many spells in the game are extremely easy to [ability:antimage_spell_shield] Counterspell without the enemy player being able to do almost anything about it most of the time. Think [hero:gyrocopter] Gyrocopter's [ability:gyrocopter_homing_missile] Homing Missile, [hero:skywrath_mage] Skywrath Mage's [ability:skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt] Arcane Bolt and so on. Against such spells utilizing optimal value from your [item:aghanims_shard] Shard is all but guaranteed.
Buy after Disperser/Manta, or later, to counter a high-evasion hero.
Buy after Disperser/Manta to counter enemy buffs which prevent you from killing your targets - ex. Ghost Scepter, Glimmer Cape, Eul's Scepter, Aeon Disk, etc.

Buy instead of [item:diffusal_blade] Diffusal Blade if you're facing an extremely high max mana enemy hero (ex. 2000+ mana) and your illusions will actually be allowed to attack him incessantly. Under ideal conditions, this would be your go to item for the abovementioned Mana Void skill build.

If you're going down the [item:manta] Manta Style route to counter high max mana heroes with the Mana Void skill build, you'll want to buy [item:ultimate_scepter|antimage] Aghanim's Scepter as your 4th item after the [item:black_king_bar] BKB. Not only will your hero's [ability:antimage_mana_break] Mana Break become much stronger, but your illusions will also start burning more mana as well.
As an added note - AM with Scepter is one of the strongest counters to [hero:obsidian_destroyer] Outworld Destroyer in the entire game. If he doesn't have active Debuff Immunity, he's virtually no longer a real hero. His mana will instantly drop to 0 and you can [ability:antimage_mana_void] Mana Void him and his surrounding teammates into oblivion.

tips.text: [ability:antimage_blink] Blink on top of an enemy hero, slow them down with [item:diffusal_blade] Diffusal Blade/[item:disperser] Disperser or use [item:manta] Manta Style to summon illusions, burn their mana, and finish them off with [ability:antimage_mana_void] Mana Void.
Always [ability:antimage_blink] Blink away from a fight if you are about to die. You are useless when dead, but extremely powerful when alive.
Farm the jungle between waves to maximize your gold income. Never stand idle.

Use [ability:antimage_spell_shield] Counterspell reactively to reflect single-target spells - such as Sven's [ability:sven_storm_bolt] Storm Bolt or Vengeful Spirit's [ability:vengefulspirit_magic_missile] Magic Missile - back at the caster.
[ability:antimage_blink] Blink through terrain to escape ganks. You can pass through cliffs and trees, not just between units.

Anti-Mage has the fastest Base Attack Time in the game. This means that bonuses to Attack Speed & Agility are even more effective on him than on most other heroes. You can learn more about this in our Base Attack Time concept page.

allies.note: AM works great with aura and/or buff supports who boost his offensive and/or defensive capabilities.

counters.note: Anti-Mage best counters heroes with mana pools in both extremes. Low max mana heroes immediately lose their ability to cast spells against him, while high max mana heroes become the perfect opportunity for Mana Void to turn into a nuclear bomb - especially in team fights.

countered_by.note: Hard CC heroes who lock down Anti-Mage for long enough, so he can be focused down & deleted. Both his survivability & ability to engage heroes on his own terms disappear in such situations.
